doc: Swipe audio map. See design/audio/AUDIO-SPEC.md. Files resolve to res://assets/audio/<name>.ogg then .wav. Keys under 'lookup' are tried in 'fallback_chain' order; first hit wins.

card_id._note: Ids are best guesses from the audit; Cursor must verify against data/catalog.json and drop/rename unknown keys.

special_id._note: Keys = monster ids; confirm against MONSTER_SPECIAL (main.gd:126–160).

deadly_sting_pitch._doc: pitch multiplier for sting.deadly + wheel.land_deadly per boss id (semitones in comment)

title.note: yd Dungeon Ambience file is ~-40 LUFS; +14 dB puts it ~-26

verdant_hollow_intro.note: Verdant Hollow (b1) one-shot intro; finished → verdant_hollow loop

verdant_hollow.note: Verdant Hollow dungeon loop after intro; bar_period_s is 4/4 at ~98.4 BPM

verdant_hollow_victory.note: Verdant Hollow (b1) dungeon-clear one-shot; bar-synced linear dual-crossfade (out 0.8× / in 0.5× bar), then soft 0.8s → between_dungeons

between_dungeons.note: Shared hold bed after dungeon clear / rope_exit rest. Same track all biomes. Starts mid-groove; loop the OGG. Enter only after clear outro via music_to (~0.8s).

cinder_forge.note: Cinder Forge (b4) Approach F layer A (Lead+Bass+Keyboard+Synth+Other+Woodwinds). Always on during the delve. bar_period_s = 60/121*4 (121 BPM 4/4).

cinder_forge_b.note: Forge intensity B (drums). Synced to A; fade in on combat, mute between fights.

cinder_forge_c.note: Forge intensity C (percussion+brass heat). Synced to A; fade in on Tier-3/boss only.

cinder_forge_victory.note: Cinder Forge (b4) dungeon-clear one-shot; splice style. Clip has baked 0.992s linear fade-in (half of 1.983s bar); loudness-matched to boss-combat mix. gain_db = A bed (-4), same convention as shadow_abyss_victory. Finished → between_dungeons soft 0.8s.

crystal_cavern.note: Crystal Cavern (b2, was sunken_mire) Approach F layer A bed. Always on during the delve. bar_period_s = 72.577/36 (36 bars wrap). bar_phase_s = measured bar-15 kick − 15×bar (downbeats early of t=0 grid). Victory splice uses this phase so engine T at mid-loop equals the measured kick.

crystal_cavern_b.note: Crystal Cavern intensity B (drums). Synced to A; fade in on combat, mute between fights.

crystal_cavern_c.note: Crystal Cavern intensity C (heat). Quiet stem; +10 dB. Synced to A; fade in on Tier-3/boss only.

crystal_cavern_victory.note: Crystal Cavern (b2) dungeon-clear one-shot. Clip has baked 30 ms linear fade-in + −9.7 dB; engine gain_db 0. Splice hybrid: start at T−0.030 at full gain; hold A/B/C through the lead; linear 1→0 over loop_out_frac×bar (~50 ms) from T. Do not use lead_in_frac or splice_out_s. Finished → between_dungeons soft 0.8s. Timing: design/audio/demo_report_crystal_cavern_victory.json.

ashen_crypt.note: Ashen Crypt (b3) Approach F layer A bed. Always on during the delve. Map -2 dB so A+B+C leave ~1.5 dB Music-bus headroom. bar_period_s = 60/113*4 (113 BPM 4/4). Victory outro v4 timing uses the plain t=0 bar grid (no bar_phase_s); outro_lead_s already places the downbeat by ear.

ashen_crypt_b.note: Ashen Crypt intensity B (drums). Synced to A; fade in on combat, mute between fights.

ashen_crypt_c.note: Ashen Crypt intensity C (percussion+brass heat). Synced to A; fade in on Tier-3/boss only.

ashen_crypt_victory.note: Ashen Crypt (b3) dungeon-clear one-shot (v4). Clip has baked linear fade-in + −5.70 dB; engine gain_db 0. Splice hybrid: start at T−0.1659375 (preroll+1/64) at full gain; hold A/B/C through the lead; linear 1→0 over 1.0×bar from T. Finished → between_dungeons soft 0.8s. Timing: design/audio/demo_report_ashen_crypt_victory_v4.json.

shadow_abyss.note: Shadow Abyss (b5) Approach F layer A bed. Always on during the delve. bar_period_s 2.4 = felt 100 BPM bar (production 200 BPM half-time feel); victory boom lands one bar after cut.

shadow_abyss_b.note: Abyss intensity B (drums). Synced to A; fade in on combat, mute between fights.

shadow_abyss_c.note: Abyss intensity C (perc+brass heat). Quiet stem; +6 dB. Synced to A; fade in on Tier-3/boss only.

shadow_abyss_victory.note: Shadow Abyss (b5) dungeon-clear one-shot; clip loudness-matched to A-2/B-2/C+6 combat mix so gain_db matches shadow_abyss A (-2). Bar-synced linear dual-crossfade; finished → between_dungeons soft 0.8s.

states.title: title
states.cinder_forge: cinder_forge A always; B combat; C Tier-3; no between-fight bed duck
states.crystal_cavern: crystal_cavern A always; B combat; C Tier-3; no between-fight bed duck
states.ashen_crypt: ashen_crypt A always; B combat; C Tier-3; no between-fight bed duck
states.shadow_abyss: shadow_abyss A always; B combat; C Tier-3; no between-fight bed duck

wheel.num_tick_atk._note: Legacy single-key ATK tick. Prefer wheel.num_tick_atk_up / _down. Sample is pluck (not ui_tick / mon_leech_pulse HP ticks).

amb.radio_static.note: dedicated ambience loop owned by the radio overlay: faint while open, louder for 600 ms on tune, stopped on close and when leaving the cabin

amb.trophy_room.doc: 48.000 s seamless hall bed at −26 LUFS in the file. Start with sfx.loop_start(&"amb.trophy_room", fade) on hall enter; loop_stop / 0.8 s crossfade out on leave. db 0 — do not apply the map default −8.

board.slide.doc: Heavy wooden panel sliding on a rail, cog click at the end (0.38 s). Replaces Package C placeholder alias of cabin.item_whoosh.

board.bump.doc: Wood knock at the end of travel (0.15 s). Replaces placeholder alias of cabin.locked.

board.hover_slot.doc: Tiny glass tick (0.05 s). cooldown_ms 60 per ASSETS.md. Replaces placeholder alias of ui.hover_menu.

board.satchel_in.doc: Leather bag lifted and set down (0.40 s). Replaces placeholder alias of cabin.item_pop.

board.satchel_rustle.doc: Leather flap and rummage (0.30 s). Replaces placeholder alias of cabin.item_pop.

board.satchel_out.doc: Bag set aside (0.30 s). Replaces placeholder alias of cabin.item_pop.

board.rise_glint.doc: Rising shimmer (0.50 s). Bus is SFX per ASSETS.md (placeholder had been UI via cabin.glint). pitch ±5%.

board.whoosh.doc: Soft airy flight (0.50 s). Replaces placeholder alias of cabin.item_whoosh.

board.poof.doc: Dusty poof with a small sparkle tail (0.30 s). Replaces placeholder alias of cabin.item_burst.

board.light_chime_1.doc: Bell chime C5 (523.25 Hz), 0.8 s, −16 dBFS peak. Play for light 1; do not also pitch-shift.

board.light_chime_2.doc: Bell chime D5 (587.33 Hz). Play for light 2.

board.light_chime_3.doc: Bell chime E5 (659.26 Hz). Play for light 3.

board.light_chime_4.doc: Bell chime G5 (783.99 Hz). Play for light 4.

board.light_chime_5.doc: Bell chime A5 (880.00 Hz). Play for light 5.

board.light_chime.doc: Fallback for the existing board.light_chime cue (homecoming.gd currently plays this with chromatic pitch_mul +1 semitone per light). That path will not land on the pentatonic C–D–E–G–A set. Prefer board.light_chime_1..5 with pitch [1,1]. File here is chime 1 (C5) only, so leftover pitch_mul does not double-pitch a pre-tuned D/E/G/A file.

board.lever_ready.doc: Warm ta-da glow swell when the 5th light lands (1.0 s). Replaces placeholder alias of sting.unlock.

board.lever_clunk.doc: Big brass lever thrown, ratchet and clunk (0.50 s). Replaces placeholder alias of cabin.stamp_thunk.

board.rumble.doc: Deep earth rumble with falling grit and a beam groan (1.70 s). duck_music −8 (attack 0.05 s, release 0.6 s) per ASSETS.md. board_sequences.gd also calls sfx.duck_music(-8) in code — keep both or drop the manual call once the cue flag is wired, but do not double-duck.

sting.portal_open.doc: Portal stinger 3.60 s at −20 LUFS with a mid scoop for Nib lines. Unresolved open chord; no melody peak after 1.5 s. duck_music −8.

board.complete_chime.doc: Gold-leaf shimmer sweep and resolved C-major chime for a 100% board (1.50 s). Replaces placeholder alias of sting.unlock.

sting.shortcut.doc: Playful secret-found pluck figure and a door-creak tail (2.40 s). duck_music −8.

board.path_draw.doc: Quill scratching across parchment (1.20 s). Replaces placeholder alias of cabin.map_pin.

board.fog_clear.doc: Breathy wind dissolve (0.90 s). Replaces placeholder whoosh alias.

board.badge_pop.doc: Paper tag pinned (0.20 s). Replaces placeholder alias of cabin.map_pin.

nib.react.doc: Package E react cue; aliases speech.nib_gasp until Reel delivers dedicated variants.

portal.fizzle.note: Dead portal click. Falls back to cabin.locked sample (cab_locked).

radio.note: The cabin bed follows the saved station while the cabin is open. Combat/deadly/title beds are untouched.
